channel.title: AMNI-SCIENT Updates
channel.description: What shipped, what it means, why it matters.

item.title: The bolts preload page
item.description: Bolt torque and preload with nut factor K, on its own page next to the calculator.

item.title: Listed — Braid, Calc, and Adam
item.description: The three you can actually use right now, in one place: Braid, Amni-Calc, and Adam.

item.title: Calc cut the lecture
item.description: Module pages keep the equation and one worked number. The syllabus walls are gone.

item.title: A Qwen path for Adam — in progress
item.description: Trying a Qwen path. Granite at ~4.6 bpw is still the baseline. No quality win yet.

item.title: Braid CLI seats and what we don't see
item.description: Cloud seats talk through the CLIs you already signed into. Prompts do not come to Amni-Scient.

item.title: Adam's GF(17)/ATEX baseline is ~4.6 bpw all-in
item.description: The working Granite baseline is about 4.6 bits per weight all-in. That is not 1 bpw, and it is not near-lossless.

item.title: Bolts and fatigue notes next to the tools
item.description: Engineer notes on the bolts and fatigue calculators — equations and one worked number, not a syllabus.

item.title: Dogfooding Browse on neverssl
item.description: I used Amni-Browse on neverssl.com so I would know if the daily driver actually works.

item.title: Braid is still $10
item.description: Open beta stays $10 a month. The seats you already pay for, one room.

item.title: Amni-Browse runs on Linux
item.description: A Linux build of the privacy-first browser. Same local-only deal as the Windows exe.

item.title: Calc's WASM kernels got a polish
item.description: The in-browser numerics are tighter. Same calculators, less friction when you iterate.

item.title: Grok Remote is easier to live with
item.description: Desktop can see every chat again, long-press reacts without a stuck bar, and cancelling a queued message puts the text back in the box.

item.title: Updates now live on amni-scient.com
item.description: A dated ship log when something you can actually use lands.

item.title: All eight Braid seats are live
item.description: ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, and OpenCode join Claude, Grok, Gemini, and a local seat at the table. Braid still drives the subscriptions you already pay for.
